rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone moves very slowly and sluggishly.

example.english: They walked in ponderously, keeping everyone waiting.
example.traditional: 佢慢吞吞咁行入嚟，搞到成班人等佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 maan6 tan1 tan1 gam3 haang4 jap6 lai4 gaau2 dou3 sing4 baan1 jan4 dang2 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when the movement looks heavy, cumbersome, or as if the person or thing has great weight.

example.english: They carried the old refrigerator ponderously into the kitchen, and both were out of breath.
example.traditional: 部舊雪櫃笨重咁搬入廚房，兩個人都抬到氣喘。
example.jyutping: bou6 gau6 syut3 gwai6 ban6 zung6 gam3 bun1 jap6 cyu4 fong2 loeng5 go3 jan4 dou1 toi4 dou3 hei3 cyun2
